title: Plain-TCP window after a short flight under BBR and under fq pacing (Reno, Cubic): stage A, n1 = 1..40 segments
serves: limitation of the paper: other congestion controllers and pacing not tested
stages: custom: run_slack.py stage A, configs base, bbr, reno_fq, cubic_fq (the last three are in CONFIGS_EXTRA, not in the default list)
status: criteria Q1-Q5 in results/g11_cc_pacing_predictions.md, fixed on 2026-11-19, before the measurement; any machine; needs the kernel modules tcp_bbr and sch_fq
